title: Relocate an address
description:
A module was built for a **preferred base**, but the loader put it at a different **actual base**. Write:

- `unsigned long long rvaOf(unsigned long long address, unsigned long long base)`: the address as an offset from the module's base.
- `unsigned long long relocate(unsigned long long stored, unsigned long long preferredBase, unsigned long long actualBase)`: the value a stored absolute address must become after the module moves. The offset from the base stays the same.

```
rvaOf(0x180001234, 0x180000000) == 0x1234
relocate(0x180001234, 0x180000000, 0x7FF600000000) == 0x7FF600001234
```
hints: The offset from the base never changes when a module moves: `rvaOf` is `address - base`.
So the relocated value is the new base plus the same offset: `actualBase + (stored - preferredBase)`.
lessonTitle: How the Loader Maps a DLL into a Process
